home.alt: The Home screen with counts for people, updates and repairs, and recent activity
home.caption: Your Home screen: counts for people, updates and repairs, and recent activity.

chat-empty.alt: An empty chat with Tessa chosen, a greeting for Sage, the Send a message box and four suggestion buttons
chat-empty.caption: Your first chat is empty. Type in the box, or tap a suggestion.

people.alt: The Family page with the People, Pets and Bots tabs and a card each for Sage, Marlow and Nova
people.caption: One card for each person in the house.

memory.alt: Settings, Your data and apps, on the Data and privacy tab, with Select memories, Clear all and one memory with an archive icon
memory.caption: Your memories are in Settings, Your data and apps, with Select memories and Clear all.

notifications.alt: The bell's notification list open with two new notices, each with a Dismiss button, and Dismiss all
notifications.caption: The bell lists new notices. Dismiss one, or Dismiss all.

notifications-history.alt: The Notifications history page with a Select button and the notices from the last 30 days
notifications-history.caption: History shows the last 30 days.

repairs.alt: The Repairs list with one warning, The search helper stopped, and Restart the search helper in the Fix column
repairs.caption: Repairs lists what needs fixing, and the Fix column says how.

roles-users.alt: The Users list showing an owner, a teen and a child, with an Add someone form
roles-users.caption: Pick a role in Add someone. It decides what the person can do.

updates.alt: The Updates table with one row for MaiPai Home
updates.caption: The Updates table: what is installed and what is available.

fit-check.alt: Settings, AI and models, on the Advanced tab, with the memory meter and the Chat card showing Qwen3 8B Instruct marked Good fit and running well on this computer
fit-check.caption: AI and models, Advanced: the page says whether a model fits this computer.

sign-in-picker.alt: The sign-in screen with a circle for Sage, Marlow and Nova
sign-in-picker.caption: Pick your own name to sign in.

sign-in-pin.alt: The passcode screen for Quill with four boxes and a Use a password instead link
sign-in-pin.caption: Type your digits, one in each box, or tap Use a password instead.

sign-in-wrong-pin.alt: The passcode screen after a wrong code, with red boxes, the line That passcode is not right, and a Use a password instead hint
sign-in-wrong-pin.caption: After a wrong code the boxes shake and you see a hint, not a lock.

child-topics.alt: The Topics tab on Nova's profile with a menu for each sensitive subject
child-topics.caption: Topics decides how MaiPai answers a child about sensitive subjects.

settings-ease.alt: Settings, Look and ease, with the Appearance card, Home layout set to Shelves and the Ease of use card with Comfort style set to Standard
settings-ease.caption: Look and ease: Appearance first, then Ease of use with Comfort style.

settings-search.alt: Settings, Search and web, with the SearXNG address box and the Web search rules
settings-search.caption: Search and web: your own search service and the rules for each age group.

settings-network.alt: Settings, Advanced, Network and access, with Away access through Tailscale, Who can reach Home and a Set up away access button
settings-network.caption: Network and access: Set up away access walks you through Tailscale.

settings-engines.alt: Settings, AI and models, on the Engines tab, with the Engine computer link card and the Roles table
settings-engines.caption: AI and models, Engines: the engine computer link and the engine for each role.

backups.alt: The Backups page with Save your backup key (Download and Print), one saved backup with a size and a Restore button, and a Back up now button
backups.caption: Backups: save your key, see each copy, and back up now.

main-menu-desktop.alt: The Home page on a computer with the icon rail on the left, an ask box, a Today row and Getting started steps
main-menu-desktop.caption: On a computer, the main menu is a column of icons on the left.

main-menu-phone.alt: The Home page on a phone with the menu button at the top left, an ask box and a Today row
main-menu-phone.caption: On a phone, tap the menu button at the top left.

setup-wizard.alt: The first setup screen, Welcome to MaiPai Home, with a Set up my Home button
setup-wizard.caption: Setup starts with a welcome and the Set up my Home button.

profile-language.alt: Settings, Profile and sign-in, with the Language card set to Use whatever the home uses
profile-language.caption: Pick your language in the Language card.

profile-language-es.alt: The Language card with Spanish picked and the page in Spanish
profile-language-es.caption: Pick Español and the page changes at once.

settings-es.alt: The Household and people settings page with menus and headings in Spanish
settings-es.caption: Settings in Spanish. Parts not yet translated show in English.

notifications-bell-es.alt: The bell's notice list on the Home screen in Spanish: the buttons and two notices in Spanish, then safety and other fixed notices that stay in English
notifications-bell-es.caption: The buttons and new notices show in the language you picked. Safety notices stay in English.

sign-in-es.alt: The sign-in passcode boxes with the prompt in Spanish
sign-in-es.caption: The sign-in page uses the home's language.
